query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM financial_records WHERE year = 2026 AND month = 1 AND type = 'income') as jan_income,
  (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM financial_records WHERE year = 2026 AND month = 1 AND type = 'expense') as jan_expense,
  (SELECT openingBalance FROM financial_balances WHERE year = 2026 AND month = 2) as feb_opening_balance,
  (SELECT openingBalance FROM financial_balances WHERE year = 2026 AND month = 1) as jan_opening_balance;
